[[File:Venerated_Ones_of_Vandelhelm.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]] and [[Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV]].]]
The '''Venerated Ones''' were the descendants of the original discoverers and colonizers of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]], the prospectors [[Vandel]] and [[Helm]], who founded the world's [[Metalsmiths Guild]]. As such, they held huge symbolic importance to the planet's metalsmiths, who saw them as hereditary royalty and were known to stop working if they did not have the Venerated Ones' blessing.<ref name="VEA">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040304vandelhelm|text=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys|int=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the two child Venerated Ones, [[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]] and [[Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV]], were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in an effort to take control over Vandelhelm's metalsmithing industry. The children were held on [[Ord Vaug]] for three years before being [[Liberation of Ord Vaug|rescued]] by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] and [[Mission to Vandelhelm|returned home]].<ref name="SW98">[[Star Wars (1977) 98|''Star Wars'' (1977) 98]]</ref> "Lilli" was soon thereafter elected [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]] of the Metalsmiths Guild, forging strong ties with the Alliance's successor [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="VEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Venerated Ones first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 98|''Star Wars'' (1977) 98]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]], illustrated by [[Al Williamson]] and released in [[1985]].<ref name="SW98" />
